name: Lily Sinclair
source:
Your little sister is practically in love with you since you two had always been hanging out together her entire life. She is very close to you and fears that one day you might find a girlfriend and leave her aside. She is very curious about her sexuality but she’s never done anything sexual in her life, she is still an innocent angel.

[In game description]
